2 Key Findings
Test SummaryThe frontend suite is largely healthy: 32 tests passed, 1 failed, and 6 were blocked. Because blocked cases are excluded from the score, the quality score is computed on the executable subset and reflects a strong but not perfect user experience. Core flows like login, registration, predictions, rankings, and most admin actions are working. The remaining risk is concentrated in two areas: admin authentication availability in production and one validation gap in extra predictions. The repeated blocked admin tests suggest an environment/data issue rather than isolated UI behavior, but the failed tests still point to a real product defect in scoring/validation.
What could be betterTwo concrete problems stand out. First, extra predictions validation is incomplete: `Extra predictions: Require extra prediction selections` failed because the app saved successfully even with Campeão, Vice-campeão, and Terceiro lugar left on `— Selecione —` and no checkboxes selected. Second, scoring propagation appears broken: `Scoring and ranking: See ranking points after a finalized match` failed because the ranking page showed `1 jogos finalizados` while `Participante Teste (você)` still had `0 pts`. In addition, 6 admin-focused tests were blocked because login repeatedly returned `E-mail ou senha inválidos.`, which suggests a production auth/database or seed/config mismatch.
RecommendationsFix the two user-visible defects first: enforce required-field validation for extra predictions on both client and server, and trace why finalized matches are not updating leaderboard points after admin save/finalize actions. Then verify production admin authentication: confirm the seeded admin account exists in the deployed database, the password hash matches the expected credentials, and session/auth env vars are correct. Once those are corrected, re-run the blocked admin tests to convert them into executable coverage. Use the fix prompt below to drive the implementation and validation pass.

TEST BLOCKED O teste não pôde ser executado — o acesso administrativo não foi obtido com as credenciais fornecidas, portanto a funcionalidade de reset por usuário não pôde ser verificada. Observations: - A página exibiu o aviso "Acesso restrito ao administrador." ao acessar /admin/usuarios, indicando que a área está bloqueada sem autenticação administrativa. - Foram realizadas múltiplas tentativas de login com gpmmac@gmail.com / M@ciel80 e a aplicação retornou a mensagem de erro "E-mail ou senha inválidos." (login não foi possível). - Sem uma sessão de administrador ativa, a ação de reset por usuário não aparece acessível na interface.
Cause
The failure is likely on the hosting side because the production deployment does not accept the provided admin credentials, which usually indicates one of these issues: the admin user was not seeded into the live database, the password hash in production differs from the expected one, or authentication depends on missing/misconfigured environment variables or session secrets after deployment. As a result, the test cannot obtain an admin session and the reset-by-user feature remains inaccessible.
Fix
Verify the production admin credentials and authentication flow on the hosting environment. Ensure the admin user gpmmac@gmail.com exists in the production database, the password matches the deployed hash, and required auth/session secrets (e.g. JWT/session secret, NEXTAUTH/APP secret, database env vars) are correctly configured on Render. If the admin account is missing or credentials were changed, recreate/update the admin user in production. Also confirm the /admin/usuarios route is protected only after successful admin login and that the reset-per-user control is rendered for authenticated admins.

Error
TEST BLOCKED Administrator access could not be obtained with the provided credentials; the test could not be run. Observations: - Three login attempts with gpmmac@gmail.com / M@ciel80 failed and showed the message 'E-mail ou senha inválidos.' - Direct navigation to /admin/jogos redirected to the public homepage which displays 'Acesso restrito ao administrador.' Because the admin area cannot be reached or used, it is not possible to attempt entering invalid match scores or verify validation feedback. The test is blocked until valid administrator credentials or admin access are available.
Cause
The most likely hosting-side issue is that the production instance does not have a valid administrator account matching the provided credentials, or the deployment is connected to the wrong database/secret set so authentication always fails. Another possibility is that the admin role/session is not being created correctly in production (for example due to missing env vars, a bad password hash, or a data seed not running), which causes /admin/jogos to redirect to the public homepage with the restricted-access message.
Fix
Verify the administrator account exists in the production database and that the supplied credentials are the correct ones for that environment. If the login is meant to succeed, reset/reseed the admin user, check for password hashing/migration mismatches, and confirm the auth/session flow is issuing the proper role claim/cookie. Also review environment variables and deployment config on Render to ensure the app is pointed at the correct database and auth secrets. If the login route is intentionally protected, provide the test with valid admin credentials or a dedicated test admin account so the admin area can be reached.

Error
TEST BLOCKED The participant management page could not be reached because administrator access is restricted and the admin session was not established. Observations: - The page displays the banner 'Acesso restrito ao administrador.' - Navigating to /admin/usuarios returned the public homepage without any users/management table visible.
Cause
The hosting side likely has an auth/routing misconfiguration in production: the admin route is either protected by a session that is never being created on the hosted environment, or the platform is rewriting /admin/usuarios to the public homepage because the route is not recognized. A common cause is missing/incorrect production session cookie configuration (Secure/SameSite/Domain), absent environment variables or admin account data, or a static rewrite rule that sends unknown paths to /, preventing the admin management page from loading.
Fix
Ensure the admin area is actually reachable on the hosted deployment: verify that the /admin/usuarios route is deployed and not being rewritten to the homepage by the hosting platform, and make sure the admin session/auth state can be established on the production domain. If the app relies on cookies or a logged-in admin session, confirm cookie domain/secure/samesite settings match the Render HTTPS domain, that session middleware is configured in production, and that the admin user/credentials exist in the production database. Also check any access-control guard so it does not block the admin page by default and instead allows authenticated admin navigation.

Error
TEST BLOCKED O teste não pôde ser executado porque o login com a conta de administrador falhou, impedindo o acesso à página de administração onde os resultados dos jogos podem ser editados. Observations: - A mensagem de erro 'E-mail ou senha inválidos.' é exibida no formulário de login. - Três tentativas de login com as credenciais fornecidas (gpmmac@gmail.com / M@ciel80) foram realizadas e todas falharam. - A página permaneceu na tela de login; a rota /admin/jogos não pôde ser acessada.
Cause
The most likely cause is a production-side authentication mismatch: the hosted app is using a different database or stale environment configuration than expected, so the admin credentials gpmmac@gmail.com / M@ciel80 do not correspond to a valid user in production, or the password hash/secret used to verify the login is inconsistent. This can happen if the admin account was not seeded in the deployed database, the app is connected to the wrong DB instance, or an auth secret changed after the account was created, making all login attempts fail with 'E-mail ou senha inválidos.'
Fix
Check the production authentication flow on the hosting side: verify that the admin user exists in the production database and that the stored password hash matches the provided credentials, ensure the app is pointing to the correct environment variables/database on Render, and inspect server logs for auth errors. If the admin account was never seeded or was created with a different password, recreate/reset it in the production database and redeploy. Also confirm any auth-related secrets (JWT/session secret, bcrypt hashing, database URL) are correctly configured and consistent across deploys.

Error
TEST FAILURE Saving the Palpites Extras did not get blocked — submission succeeded despite required tournament selections being left empty. Observations: - After clicking '💾 Salvar palpites extras', the page displayed a green banner: '✅ Palpites extras salvos com sucesso!'. - The Campeão, Vice-campeão, and Terceiro lugar selects remain on '— Selecione —' and no selection checkboxes were checked, yet the save succeeded.
Cause
The hosted app is likely missing or bypassing required-field validation in the save handler for "palpites extras". The submit action probably only checks that the request was sent successfully and always shows a success banner, even when the tournament prediction fields are still at their default "— Selecione —" state and no checkboxes are selected. This can happen if validation exists only in the frontend, if the backend endpoint accepts incomplete payloads, or if the deployed build is stale and does not include the latest validation logic.
Fix
Enforce validation on the server/API that handles saving "palpites extras" so it rejects submissions unless Campeão, Vice-campeão, and Terceiro lugar are all selected and the required checkbox picks are present. Also add client-side validation/disabled submit state as a UX safeguard, but do not rely on it alone. If the form is being saved directly to a backend endpoint or serverless function on Render, verify that the deployed code includes the validation logic and that the hosting environment is not serving an older build or bypassing the validation path.

Error
TEST FAILURE The ranking did not update the participant's points after a match was finalized by the admin. Observations: - The Ranking page indicates '1' jogos finalizados (1 finalized game). - The logged-in participant 'Participante Teste (você)' row displays '0 pts'. - Multiple leaderboard rows show 0 points, indicating no scoring update was applied.
Cause
The hosting-side issue is likely that the match-finalization event is not propagating into the ranking data source in production. In other words, the admin can mark a game as finalized, but the service that recalculates participant points may be failing, not deployed, misconfigured, or writing to a different environment/database. Another common cause is aggressive caching on the ranking endpoint/page, so the finalized match count updates but the leaderboard points remain stale. This would explain why the page shows 1 finalized game while all participants still display 0 points.
Fix
Verify the production backend flow that updates standings after an admin finalizes a match. The most likely fix is to ensure the finalize-match action actually persists the result and triggers the points recalculation/aggregation for the ranking table, then writes those updated points back to the database or cache used by the ranking page. Check for a broken API route, missing server-side job, disabled webhook/event handler, or stale cached leaderboard response in the hosting environment. Also confirm the frontend is reading from the correct production API/base URL and that any background worker or cron responsible for recomputing rankings is deployed and running on Render.

Error
TEST BLOCKED Admin authentication could not be performed — the provided admin credentials did not allow login and admin-only features cannot be reached. Observations: - The login page displays the error 'E-mail ou senha inválidos.' - Three login attempts were made with the provided credentials (gpmmac@gmail.com / M@ciel80) and all failed. - Admin pages (required to record extra prediction results) are inaccessible without successful authentication.
Cause
The most likely hosting-side issue is that the production deployment is not aligned with the expected admin credentials: the live database may be missing the admin user, may contain an older password hash, or may be connected to a different dataset than the one used in testing. Another common cause is misconfigured environment variables/secret keys in production, which can make valid credentials fail authentication even though the login flow works. As a result, the site returns 'E-mail ou senha inválidos.' for the provided admin account and blocks access to admin-only features.
Fix
Verify the hosted environment is using the correct authentication backend and seeded admin account. Check whether production is pointing to the wrong database, stale environment variables, or a user record that was never created/updated. If passwords are stored hashed, ensure the deployed secret(s) and hash algorithm match the account that should exist. Recreate or reset the admin user in the live database with the provided credentials, confirm email normalization/case handling, and redeploy with the correct production config so the admin login succeeds.

import asyncio
import re
from playwright import async_api
from playwright.async_api import expect
async def run_test():
    pw = None
    browser = None
    context = None
    try:
        # Start a Playwright session in asynchronous mode
        pw = await async_api.async_playwright().start()
        # Launch a Chromium browser in headless mode with custom 
        arguments
        browser = await pw.chromium.launch(
            headless=True,
            args=[
                "--window-size=1280,720",
                "--disable-dev-shm-usage",
                "--ipc=host",
                "--single-process"

        # Wider default timeout to match the agent's DOM-stability 
        budget;
        # auto-waiting Playwright APIs (expect, locator.wait_for) 
        inherit this.
        context.set_default_timeout(15000)
        # Open a new page in the browser context

        await elem.fill("gpmmac@gmail.com")
        
        # -> Preencher os campos E-mail e Senha com as credenciais 
        do administrador e clicar em 'Entrar' para autenticar a 
        conta.
        # password input name="senha"
        elem = page.locator("xpath=/html/body/main/div/div/form/div

        await elem.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=10000)

        # -> Fill email and password fields (clearing them first) 
        and click Entrar to attempt login once more, then verify 
        whether authentication succeeded.
        # button "Entrar"

        button").nth(0)
        await elem.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=10000)
        await elem.click()
        
        # --> Assertions to verify final state
        assert await page.locator("xpath=//*[contains(., 'Palpites 
        extras salvos com sucesso')]").nth(0).is_visible(), "The 
        page should display a success confirmation after saving the 
        extra predictions."
        
        # --> Test blocked by environment/access constraints during 
        agent run
        # Reason: TEST BLOCKED O teste não pôde ser executado — não 
        foi possível autenticar com a conta administrativa 
        fornecida. Observations: - A mensagem "E-mail ou senha 
        inválidos." aparece após submeter o formulário de login. - 
        Foram feitas 3 tentativas de login com o e-mail 
        'gpmmac@gmail.com' e a senha fornecida sem sucesso.
        raise AssertionError("Test blocked during agent run: " + 
        "TEST BLOCKED O teste n\u00e3o p\u00f4de ser executado 
        \u2014 n\u00e3o foi poss\u00edvel autenticar com a conta 
        administrativa fornecida. Observations: - A mensagem 
        \"E-mail ou senha inv\u00e1lidos.\" aparece ap\u00f3s 
        submeter o formul\u00e1rio de login. - Foram feitas 3

        cannot reproduce a PASS in this environment.")
        await asyncio.sleep(5)
    finally:
        if context:
            await context.close()
        if browser:
            await browser.close()
        if pw:
            await pw.stop()
asyncio.run(run_test())
    
Error
TEST BLOCKED O teste não pôde ser executado — não foi possível autenticar com a conta administrativa fornecida. Observations: - A mensagem "E-mail ou senha inválidos." aparece após submeter o formulário de login. - Foram feitas 3 tentativas de login com o e-mail 'gpmmac@gmail.com' e a senha fornecida sem sucesso.
Cause
The hosted app is likely using a production database or auth configuration that does not contain the expected administrative credentials, so the login endpoint rejects the supplied email/password as invalid. Common hosting-side reasons include missing or changed environment variables after deployment, a reset/empty database on Render, a failed seed/migration that never created the admin user, or a mismatch between the password hashing/secret used in production and the one used to generate the stored credential.
Fix
Verify and restore the admin account in the hosting environment (Render). Check whether the production database seed/migrations created the expected admin user, whether the password hash matches the provided credential, and whether environment variables for auth (e.g. ADMIN_EMAIL, ADMIN_PASSWORD, JWT/session secret) are correctly set in Render. If the account was lost or reset, recreate the admin user in the production DB with the correct email and a password hashed using the same algorithm as the app expects, then redeploy/restart so the service picks up the corrected configuration.
